body.x: Mokibo (CEO Cho Eun-Hyeong) participated in the world’s largest IT and electronics exhibition, CES 2024, held in Las Vegas from January 9th (Tuesday) to 12th (Friday).

Mokibo is a Korean startup leading innovation in the input device sector by introducing the ‘Fusion Keyboard’ product line, considered the next-generation mainstream. Their products differentiate themselves by incorporating a touchpad that can control the entire keyboard surface, surpassing the advantages of traditional mechanical keyboards.

The touchpad implemented in Mokibo’s keyboard product line boasts three times the width compared to a standard laptop touchpad, offering exceptional versatility. The widespread adoption of such hybrid keyboards is expected to reduce plastic consumption and waste from mouse production by an estimated 1,800 tons annually.

Furthermore, Mokibo’s Fusion Keyboard reduces arm movement significantly compared to using a keyboard and mouse separately. This feature helps alleviate muscle fatigue, preventing musculoskeletal disorders for modern office workers.

The Fusion Keyboard product line from Mokibo is classified into six categories, each compatible with various devices and operating systems, including iOS, PadOS, MacOS, Android, and Windows series. With efficient multi-pairing functionality, the keyboard can connect to up to three Bluetooth devices, enhancing its versatility.

body.cap: Mokibo showcased their Fusion Keyboard product at CES 2024 in Las Vegas on January 9th (local time). | Photo - AVING News

body.x: In addition to features like a stand function for mobile devices, water resistance, and a battery life of up to 60 hours, Mokibo’s Fusion Keyboard meets the needs of consumers who seek a comfortable and stable typing experience with non-contact touch switches.

Mokibo showcased its diverse and advantageous Fusion Keyboard product line as a highlight at CES 2024, attracting the attention of attendees worldwide. With this exhibition, Mokibo aims to strengthen collaboration with global laptop and tablet PC manufacturers and plans to focus on product enhancement and system integration.

In pursuit of expanding the market for the keyboard product line, Mokibo actively engaged with buyers and representatives from various countries at the exhibition, enhancing its global-oriented marketing activities.

body.cap: CEO Cho Eun-Hyeong of Mokibo is presenting their Fusion Keyboard product to global attendees at CES 2024 in Las Vegas on January 9th (local time). | Photo - AVING News

body.x: CEO Cho Eun-Hyeong of Mokibo expressed, “At this CES, Mokibo successfully captured the attention of numerous buyers and raised interest in the Fusion Keyboard product line. The event was meaningful, providing opportunities to meet with buyers from North America, Europe, Chile, and Thailand, influential IT YouTubers, and engineers from global smart device manufacturers. The biggest achievement was exploring possibilities for creating new paths in the B2B market, and it even opened up considerations for starting sales in the North American market. Moreover, we have gained confidence in future achievements by gaining insights into industry trends and needs in the keyboard sector and receiving positive feedback from potential end-users encountering our products for the first time.”

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition organized by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), is held in Las Vegas every January, providing a comprehensive view of global technology industry trends.
